contract: design-contract.md; local preview only, source origin/main 3813bda55be7b77108344de6e5cc6bd74c51f034

accessibility.evidence: Playwright keyboard skip-to-main and visible focus exercised; labeled native controls and ruby/lang Hanzi; axe selected A/AA tags reported no violations on seven initial routes at each target viewport. Real screen-reader/device UAT remains untested.

responsive.evidence: Seven routes have no document horizontal overflow at 360x800 and 1440x1000; schedule also checked at 320/720 CSS px. Mobile day selector wraps, bottom navigation and desktop sidebar inspected. Actual browser zoom not claimed.

loading.reason: There is no asynchronous data fetch/save state in synchronous in-memory fixtures. Generic App Router loading fallback is implemented but not demonstrated by throttled navigation; this is explicitly unverified in verification.md, not a loading-behavior PASS.

empty.evidence: Real progress empty state, new-tab demo empty state, exhausted review queue and restart exercised in browser tests.

error.evidence: Schedule invalid numeric input/day selection and limited-capacity consent errors, lesson answer-required feedback, and 404 lesson recovery exercised. Generic runtime exception boundary untested.

partial.evidence: Lesson screen renders text fixture with explicit missing review/audio/server grading notice; dashboard separates projected budget from unavailable actual remaining time. Representative desktop/mobile screenshots inspected.

success.evidence: Schedule applies to tab context, all four lessons complete with fixture-only feedback, four flashcard ratings exhaust the demo queue and activity appears only in demo progress. Reload resets activity.

permission.reason: No account/auth, media capture, provider call or device permission request exists in this local preview. Production authorization gates remain unimplemented.

renderedEvidence.observation: Rendered desktop Today: sidebar, one main sample CTA, projected 270-minute capacity and explicit missing actual time, four lesson links and right-hand study note; no overlapping text observed.

Rendered mobile schedule: single column, validation summary and capacity warning, 4+3 day controls, explicit reduced-capacity consent and active apply action; all content reachable by scrolling without horizontal overflow.
Rendered mobile lesson: Hanzi, ruby pinyin, Vietnamese meaning, selected wrong answer and fixture feedback; primary next action is visible by scrolling.
